takeaways: Unused but strongest: the overhead pasta flatlay (April 2023 Photos #326) is the cleanest landscape still for the CSMP cover or case-study hero. The Fire Roasted Tomato Soup stills (soup folder #1, April #125) should sit next to the soup hero clip on work/csmp and in the themed-content-calendar blog. The overalls influencer holding meal-prep containers (#305) and the Sweat Bar plating candid prove influencer-marketing better than anything now on that page. The masala landscape and the Expert in the Kitchen reel cover can illustrate the themed series. Keep the Dec 2022 wood-grain graphics and story screenshots off the site: they look dated and carry published typos ('TESTIMONAL', 'FRIJOLAS').
